Persist Profile-scoped Issue aliases and freeze Issue prefixes (#139)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-22
  description: |-
    Add a Profile-scoped PostgreSQL alias namespace that maps Workspace keys and Issue prefixes to one Workspace owner. Migration 0111 backfills current aliases, collapses same-Workspace key/prefix pairs, and fails clearly on cross-Workspace collisions without rewriting historical Issue identifiers.
    
    Workspace creation writes both aliases transactionally. Prefix updates serialize on the Workspace row lock shared with Issue creation, no-op on normalized equality, freeze with PrefixAlreadyInUse after any Issue exists, and otherwise replace alias and prefix atomically.
    
    A focused resolver maps Profile + IssueReference + optional expected Workspace through alias roles and Issue number to IssueId, returning preferred uppercase prefix and legacy key forms. Expected-Workspace mismatch is not found.
